mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 6.0% signals tightening labor market conditions, reducing wage pressures and boosting corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances when UNRATE < 6.0%, or average return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 235.0, it signals elevated inflation expectations prompting Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in 60% or more of periods when CPIAUCSL > 235.0, or average return is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO above 100.0) indicates expanding manufacturing output, boosting corporate earnings growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when INDPRO > 100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1100.0 (thousands of units) signals strong residential construction activity, indicating robust consumer demand and positive economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of instances when HOUST > 1100.0, or average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signal rapidly tightening labor market conditions, increasing corporate profit margins and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when PAYEMS is rising and UNRATE is falling, or interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales exceeding 450000.0 (millions of dollars) indicates strong consumer spending, accelerating corporate revenue growth and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in 60% or more of periods when RSAFS > 450000.0, or average return is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
